job.job_description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Enterprise AI applications using LLMs, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
Build AI-powered products for Supply Chain, ERP, Procurement, and other enterprise domains.
Develop RAG-based solutions, AI Agents, and Enterprise Knowledge Systems.
Build scalable AI services using Python, LangChain/LangGraph, and modern AI frameworks.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, and cloud platforms.
Optimize AI model performance, scalability, security, and production deployment.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions.
Required Skills
5–15 years of software engineering / AI development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
Proficiency in Python, LangChain/LangGraph, and AI application development.
Experience with RAG, Vector Databases, Semantic Search, and Knowledge Systems.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Databricks, or similar enterprise data platforms.
Experience with FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
Good understanding of LLMOps, AI Governance, and cloud-based AI deployment.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
